prompt: Reproducible terminal workspaces 2025-2026: compare byobu (6.x, tmux backend 3.4) session profiles, tmuxp, tmuxinator, tmux scripting and Zellij KDL layouts for declaring complex pane layouts (splits, sizes, names) plus the processes each pane must launch, so an app can create a ready-to-use terminal environment with zero manual setup. Answer as a comparison table plus a recommended declarative format, with sources.

tmux control mode (tmux -CC, as used by iTerm2) integration in a custom terminal UI: protocol messages (%output, %layout-change, %window-add, etc.), mapping tmux panes to native UI panels, existing open-source implementations or libraries for Node.js/Electron, limitations with tmux 3.4, and whether byobu works on top of control mode. Answer with concrete protocol details and links.

Embedding tmux or byobu inside xterm.js 5/6 through node-pty in an Electron app: best settings for true color, mouse, resize/reflow, scrollback, Unicode width, performance with many panes, and known pitfalls (TERM, escape sequences, status bar). Answer as a checklist with sources.

Letting an AI agent supervise processes running in tmux panes safely: reading output (capture-pane, pipe-pane, control-mode %output), detecting readiness/completion, sending input without shell injection (send-keys -l, bracketed paste), tmux hooks and wait-for for structured events, and audit logging. Answer with recommended patterns and anti-patterns.

Isolation and security for per-component tmux servers in a desktop app: one tmux socket per capsule (-L/-S), permissions, environment allowlists (no secret leakage), resource limits per pane (systemd scopes, cgroups), clean teardown of process trees, and multi-user concerns. Answer as a hardening guide with sources.

For an Electron + Vue 3 + Dockview SaaS where every panel ('capsule') can host an AI agent supervising its own processes, which architecture is better: (a) one node-pty per pane rendered as separate Dockview panels, (b) one tmux/byobu session per capsule rendered in a single xterm.js, or (c) tmux control mode mapped to native panes? Compare persistence (survive renderer reload), AI observability, UX, complexity and performance, and give a recommendation.
